title: Full Marathon Races in Malaysia 2026-2027: Full Guide
intro: August is the busiest month on this list, with five full marathons running from Bintulu on the 2nd to Alor Setar, Malaysia Marathon in Kuala Lumpur, and the Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang all landing before the month is out. The other cluster comes in November, when Bentong, Sandakan, Sibu and Selangor's Cyberjaya race fall within weeks of each other. Between these two peaks you're choosing between East Malaysian courses in Sarawak and Sabah (Bintulu, Kuching, Sibu, Sandakan) and Peninsular races stretching from Alor Setar in the north to Kuala Terengganu on the east coast. Kuala Lumpur anchors the calendar with the Standard Chartered marathon in October, while things thin out to single races in December, January and as far ahead as April 2027 in Terengganu.

faqs.question: Which month has the most marathon options in Malaysia?
faqs.answer: August, with five full marathons: Bintulu Marathon (Aug 2), Sarawak Energy Marathon in Kuching (Aug 9), Alor Setar Marathon (Aug 14), and both Malaysia Marathon and Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang landing on Aug 30. November follows with four races, including Sandakan and Sibu on the same date, November 22.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the KL Standard Chartered Marathon and the Penang Bridge Marathon?
faqs.answer: KLSCM runs in Kuala Lumpur on October 4 with four distances (42.195/21.1/10/5km), a city-course event. Penang Bridge International Marathon is in George Town on December 13 with three distances (42.195/21.1/10km) and is known for its bridge crossing, a different setting entirely from KL's urban roads.

faqs.question: Are all the full marathon distances the same length?
faqs.answer: Most list the standard 42.195km, but the Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang in Gertak Sanggul on August 30 is listed at 41.76km, slightly short of the standard distance, so it's worth checking course details if you're chasing an official marathon time.
